description: For the main structure of a 70 m office tower, our Part 4 wind design would use only the static procedure. The lowest natural frequency is 2 Hz, the minimum effective width is 30 m, and the site study identifies no wake buffeting or channelling. We want to treat the tower as not dynamically sensitive because its frequency is high.
known_facts: main structural wind design under Part 4
no wake buffeting or channelling identified

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: The static procedure alone is used for a building classified as dynamically sensitive by height.

should_cite.why: Height over 60 m independently triggers the dynamically-sensitive classification.

must_not_cite.why: High frequency alone does not override the building-height classification.

gold.engineering_reason: The described design is explicitly carried out under Part 4, requiring a registered professional skilled in the work.
